Architecture.title: Built for Absolute Resilience
Architecture.subtitle: Wislet eliminates server lag and single points of failure through a decentralized offline-first architecture.
Architecture.core1Desc: Transactions are committed locally in under 2ms. Zero loading spinners, zero timeouts, zero dependence on network availability.
Architecture.core2Desc: Supabase Edge Functions orchestrate seamless conflict-free state synchronization the millisecond an internet handshake occurs.
Architecture.core3Desc: Local databases are guarded by OS-level biometric encryption (FaceID / Fingerprint). Your financial blueprint never leaves your control.
Architecture.core4Desc: Receipt images are processed via computer vision pipelines, extracting amounts, categories, and merchant metadata automatically.

FAQ.title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.subtitle: Everything you need to know about CortexFin architecture and security.
FAQ.a1: Yes. Wislet uses a local SQLite database. You can create transactions, wallets, and budgets with zero internet. It syncs in the background once you're online.
FAQ.a2: Bank-level security. PIN code and Biometrics (FaceID/TouchID) lock your app. Your cloud data is secured by Supabase RLS policies.
FAQ.q3: Can I share my budget with my partner?
FAQ.a3: Absolutely. You can invite members to specific wallets and assign them strict roles: Owner, Editor, or Viewer.
